name: Precise measurement, a true-projection drawing sheet, and full control of your data
summary: Version 2.70 measures tube walls, arcs and edge-to-face distances directly, draws sheets in true projection, opens every export cleanly, and shows you exactly what the app keeps.

highlights.title: Measure walls, arcs and edges
highlights.text: Pick a tube's outside and its bore to get the wall thickness, measure between arcs and from an edge to a face, and see a part placed inside another flagged as interference. Mesh-based distances are labelled as such.

highlights.title: A drawing sheet in true projection
highlights.text: A true isometric view, orthographic views aligned for either up axis, outlines on curved parts, bores at their true width, and a title block with the scale, units and projection symbol.

highlights.title: Exports that open cleanly
highlights.text: CSV exports are protected against spreadsheet formulas, symbols such as ° and ± display correctly in Excel, and file names keep your model's name in any language, Arabic and Chinese included.

highlights.title: Units read from the file
highlights.text: COLLADA and 3MF models open at their true size, STEP and IGES models are labelled in millimetres, and an empty or damaged STL, STEP or IGES file gets a clear, plain message.

highlights.title: Your data, visible and removable
highlights.text: AI features send nothing until you set up your own endpoint. The privacy dialog lists what the app keeps in your browser, and one button removes all of it. The licence is readable inside the app.

highlights.title: Hardened against hostile files
highlights.text: Part names, file names, project files and AI replies are always displayed as plain text, never run as script, in the app, its drawings and its reports.

notes: Measurement: "Distance (parallel)" is the perpendicular offset between parallel edges, and the gap between the bounded edges is listed separately when it differs. Arc and edge-to-face distances are taken along the edges themselves.
Drawing sheets: new sheets follow the viewer's Up axis; the isometric view shows no hidden lines and states its own scale when it differs from the orthographic views.
The 4K export is called "PNG image (4K, Realistic style)": a raster capture 3,840 pixels wide.
Tolerance stacks: the RSS card, CSV and report say when a contributor uses a distribution that RSS does not model. The CSV states units and writes numbers to 12 significant digits.
Working in the app: Close all models asks before discarding unsaved review work, Escape closes the top dialog, and the navigation bar stays visible in windows down to 930 pixels wide.
Tutorial narration: voices produced by a browser vendor's online speech service are marked "online" in the voice list.
